items.info: Pick a location and a WWTP to see its registration characteristics, latest inspection photo and details, and each monitored parameter's trend. Reads the comprehensive monitoring form.

Each plant is judged once on its latest monitoring against the DWS mandatory rule:
  BOD < 40 AND COD < 100 AND TDS < 1000 mg/L
Compliant = passes all three. Non-compliant plants are stacked by which parameter they failed, so one plant can appear in more than one failure segment. No information available = registered plants with no usable effluent values.
pH and nitrate are shown as advisory dot strips on the Water quality tab and deliberately do not affect this verdict — DWS lists only BOD, COD and TDS as mandatory.
items.description: Compliant = passes all three mandatory DWS parameters. The non-compliant bar is split by the parameter that failed.

items.info:
Share of plants per combination of Effluent test method (Lab Test / Testing Kits / Other) on the latest monitoring. Multi-select, so a plant choosing more than one appears as its own combination. Plants that recorded no method fall into No information available.
Comprehensive form question 1748917751258 · Quick form question 1748919506489.

Count, per plant, how many OHS and maintenance checks its latest monitoring confirms in the healthy state:
  • Do you have an OHS Policy for the Plant? = Yes
  • Do your staff use OHS equipment at the workplace? = Yes
  • Do plant staff comply with the requirements of the OHS Policy? = Yes
  • Working tools? = Yes
  • OHS equipment available? = Yes
  • Do you have urgent maintenance programs? = No — inverted, an outstanding urgent job is a warning, matching the tone the condition matrix already gives it
  • Do you have planned preventative maintenance programs? = Yes
  • Do you have any upgrading programs? = Yes
This counts confirmed assurance; it is not a score out of 8, so the bars are not a performance ranking. The checks sit in two question groups — three in Staff and general information, five in Plant conditions — and a plant whose submission covers only the second is asked five, not eight. A bar therefore makes no claim about questions nobody put to that plant. All eight are asked on the Comprehensive monitoring form only, so a plant whose monitoring is all Quick is absent from the chart rather than scoring low.
A check counts only when it is confirmed healthy. Unanswered and answered-badly both read as not confirmed — a deliberate merge, so a low bar means little assurance rather than proven failure.
items.description: How many OHS and maintenance checks each plant has confirmed compliant on its latest monitoring. Every plant answering at least one check is counted; a plant is asked five or eight depending on which question groups its submission covers.
